title: VONE Realm F3X
features:
Unanchor All: Makes every part in the game fall down.
​Mass Delete: Instantly removes all parts in the workspace.
​Fling Parts: Makes all parts spin and fly around to hit players.
​Explode Map: Triggers explosions on every single part.
​Void All: Teleports all building parts into the void.
​2. Trolling & Fun
​Decal Spam: Covers every surface with a specific image ID.
​Skybox Changer: Replaces the sky with any image you choose.
​Disco Mode: Makes all parts flash in random RGB colors.
​Jumpscare: Displays a scary image and plays a loud sound for everyone.
​Server Lag: Spawns many parts quickly to slow down the server.
​3. Player & Admin Tools
​Kill All: Removes all other players from the game.
​Freeze All: Stops everyone from moving.
​Mass TP: Teleports all players to your current position.
​Anti-F3X: Disables F3X tools for everyone except you.
​Noclip: Allows you to walk through walls and buildings.
​4. Visuals & Effects
​RGB UI: Makes your script interface change colors constantly.
​Selection Glow: Changes the F3X selection box to a bright Neon color.
​Fog Control: Changes the thickness and color of the game fog.
​Ambient Flash: Cycles the game lighting brightness
